title: Correctness of the Encoded Action Payload
statement: Let $k,n\in\mathbb N$, let $a$ be an action for a $k$-tape binary machine with states indexed by $\{0,\ldots,n\}$, and let $bits$ assign a binary digit to each of the $4k+4$ positions in a record. If the word formed from these bits is the initial $4k+4$-bit segment of the serialized action $a$, then decoding the record payload yields the same input-head movement, work-tape actions, and output symbol as $a$, with no successor state.
